blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House prosecution will question the authenticity of any alleged prenuptial agreement between Vice President Sara Duterte and her husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, will be questioned. House private prosecutor Lorna Kapuna made that statement in an interview with anchor Pinky Webb during her show, “On Point,” on Bilyonaryo News Channel. Kapunan was anticipating the possibility that Duterte’s defense team might present such a document when the impeachment trial resumes to challenge the inclusion of Carpio’s properties and financial records in the case.
